name: VANDIRA Evidence & Recommendation Protocol
purpose: Convert retrieved evidence into an auditable confidence assessment, explicit conflicts/gaps, and a bounded next-best research or consultant action.

confidence_policy.high: At least two aligned relevant evidence items with tier-1 primary or structured support and no unresolved conflict.
confidence_policy.medium: One strong primary/structured source or multiple reputable secondary sources without unresolved conflict.
confidence_policy.low: No authoritative evidence, insufficient breadth, stale evidence for a current claim, or unresolved material conflict.

recommendation_policy.principle: Recommend the next evidence-backed research or operational information step, not an unsupported political outcome.
blocked_when: current claim has no fresh evidence
recommendation_policy.forecast_rule: Forecasts are scenario analyses with assumptions; never invent probabilities or certainty.
recommendation_policy.political_safety: Do not use sensitive personal attributes for political targeting or persuasion.

source_priority: ECI and other official primary sources
